Sources swept: `docs/status/exactness-inventory.md` ("Currently failing / not-yet-met" + Tier-3 rows), `findings-index.md` (keyword grep), the flagged `findings/F{N}-*.md` (open/remaining sections, following `[[links]]`), `docs/roadmaps/next-steps.md`, `docs/theory/key-decisions.md`, `tail docs/status/changelog.md`. Prior audit reached F244; this pass integrates F245–F256 **and** the F178 full-tensor gravity adoption (F183/F192) that had not been reflected in the ledger.*

**How to read this:** an OPEN item is a *target* — a number/claim not yet derived. A CLOSED-NEGATIVE item (Part B) is a *result* — a proven free parameter, exact no-go, or settled null; it does not need further "derivation" and should not be re-attacked as if open. A CLOSED-BY-DECISION item (Part C) is a founding posit adopted after every derivation route was closed. Before starting any open item, re-check its anchor finding — the frontier moves.

## Structural note — gravity foundational law changed (F178, integrated this audit)

The gravity sector **adopted the full stress-energy tensor as the fundamental source** (F178, DECISION 2026-06-29): the canonical law is the induced Einstein equation $G_{\mu\nu}=(8\pi G/c^4)T_{\mu\nu}$; the energy-only $\nabla^2\ln K=-8\pi T^{00}$ (F106) is reclassified as its static weak-field reduction. Consequences for this ledger:

- **F114 horizon-free dielectric black hole is superseded** — the exact vacuum solution is Schwarzschild/Kerr (the exponential $K=e^{2u}$ is PPN-order only); the $+4.6\%$ shadow and horizon-free throat were artifacts of treating the dielectric metric as fundamental. Paper VIII deprecated. This retires a former *prediction*, not an open derivation.
- **Interior dynamics become GR/TOV** (F173/F176/F181/F184): a single impedance-locked scalar forces anisotropic stress, so inside matter the metric carries its second function. Strong-field build-outs still scoped (engineering, **not** underived free parameters): Kerr/frame-dragging $T_{0i}$ on the two-function kernel; tabulated-EoS TOV for an absolute NICER placement.
- **The CC magnitude is reopened** under this law — see **G1** above. This is the single most consequential change since the last audit.
